instruction.text: What kind of person are they? Choose.

atoms.a: I love to go out and go dancing! It’s so fun, and it puts me in a good mood. I don’t like to be sad. I like to be happy, so I go dancing often.

Right now, we have loads of work to do, and it’s quite tiring. Some days, we work from early in the morning until late at night, but we won’t give up and be lazy. We’ll do our job well because it’s what we should do.

When my brother and I argue, we often say very mean and hurtful things to each other. It makes us both angry and sad sometimes, but we won’t stop doing it. No, we want to make the other person feel bad.
People around me tell me I can be quite rude, but I don’t care. I’m never rude to children though. Children are still learning, so I’m nice to them. Besides, they’re cute, whereas adults are not.
atoms.b: Peter treats adults ((rudely)), but speaks ((kindly)) to children.

atoms.a: My work desk has to be clean and perfectly organised. I hate having a messy desk when I am writing, but I don’t really care about how messy my house is. I’m just too lazy to tidy it.
atoms.b: Salma organises her work desk ((neatly)), but lives ((messily)).

atoms.a: I’m in the debate club at school, and always make sure to speak loudly when debating. I’m usually a quiet person, and my friends always tell me to repeat what I just said because they didn’t hear it.
atoms.b: Dhruv speaks ((loudly)) when debating, but ((quietly)) when talking to his friends.

atoms.a: I am a kind person. I notice that a student of mine, Denys, seems gloomy when it is time to go home. What am I likely to do?
atoms.sound: I am a kind person. I notice that a student of mine, Dennis, seems gloomy when it is time to go home. What am I likely to do?
b: ++ask Denys what is wrong and try to help him
ignore Denys because I don’t care about him

atoms.a: I am a lazy person. I have to hand in an essay for history on Friday. It’s Wednesday, and I still don’t have any idea what to write. What am I likely to do?
b: cry because it makes me sad
help my friend with their essay

atoms.a: I am a cheerful person. I get a bad mark in my maths test even though I study hard for tests. I am sad now. What am I likely to do?
b: ++do something fun to cheer myself up
give up on school because I think I am stupid
shout angrily at my maths teacher
lie in bed and cry sadly
